title: RBI Unveiled 'Utkarsh 2029' Strategy Framework for FY26-29
summary: RBI medium-term roadmap sets 49 deliverables across 6 pillars, including an indigenous AI framework and central bank digital currency (CBDC (central bank digital sovereign currency)) expansion.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Unveiled 'Utkarsh 2029' Strategy Framework for FY26-29. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI Governor unveiled **'Utkarsh 2029'**, the central bank's medium-term strategy framework covering FY2026-29 with 49 specific deliverables.
**6 Pillars**: Robust Regulations, Customer Centricity, Competitive Markets, Effective Technology, Future-Ready Organisation, and Global Integration.
**AI & LLM**: Development of an indigenous central-bank-specific LLM tool and an AI regulatory framework for financial institutions.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
